title: W5 comment falsely claims the fast-path PIPE_DRAWN lands inside the per-tick stats window; live vs replay stats streams actually diverge on wire-draw ticks
detail: The append happens in handle_input (line 452), after the frame's hash and before the next frame's events_before capture — so it sits BELOW the mark and is excluded from every live per-tick window, while replay hashes it at the apply tick. tick_events bytes feed state_hash (core/serialize.odin:435-436), so the claimed byte-identity is false and the adjacent 'app stream is replay-identical' claim now breaks on wire-draw ticks.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment: the event rides the audio consumer's audio_mark only, never the stats window; the live stats/overlay stream omits PIPE_DRAWN on draw ticks (diagnostics-only divergence). Alternatively move/emit it inside the next step's window if stream equality is actually wanted.
